answer: Register one mesa cistern warden per applicant, 120 days, 150 token deposit, 90 dollar license. Numbered shale slabs line the cistern floor, fed by a metered pipe from a summit spring. Weekly the warden dips the water level, logs inflow, and a neighbor signs the tally. A ranger checks the log twice against meter and photos. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the warden 180 days. Faking 10,000 cisterns freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars. A cistern is like a named rain barrel: anyone can check the water line, and a dry barrel with a full log gives the thief away.
